text: As Expected. These plastic containers arrived as expected. The shape and size are good. There was no damage to them. I do think they are a bit pricey for what they are.

product_metadata.title: Stock Your Home 96-Ounce Plastic Candy Jars (2 Pack) Wide Mouth PVC Cookie Jars with Snap-On Lids - Shatter-Proof Pantry Containers - Clear Round Storage Jars for Laundry Detergent, Toys, Tool Parts
features: 96-Ounce Round PVC Jars: Store cookies, candies, chocolates, pretzels, popcorn, snacks, and more in our 96 oz plastic round jars. Made of premium quality PVC material, our jars are reusable and recyclable. Our value pack comes with 2 plastic round jars, each with a maximum capacity of 96-ounces. Our lid measures 100mm. *Not dishwasher safe.

Super Space Saver: Specially designed with a double base, our plastic cookie jar can be oriented on its side for an angled-opening, or on its bottom for a top-opening. This makes it easy to store our jars on countertops, shelves, pantries, and other small areas in your home. Great for small kitchens and pantries, studio apartments, dorm rooms, offices, reception desks, and more!

Wide Mouth Design: Our jar features a 110mm wide-mouth opening, making it easy to access and refill the contents of the jar. The wide mouth is also the perfect size to conveniently keep a scoop for dispensing. Perfect for storing sugar, flour, grains, cereal, bath salts, laundry detergent, and more!

Snap-On Lids: Our snap-on lids provide a tight seal that prevents minor spills and leaks. The secure closure also prevents odors from permeating the contents of the candy storage containers. Perfect for pantry goods like coffee beans, keurig coffee pods, tea bags, and snacks. Use them to store children’s toys like small action figures, lego blocks, and puzzle pieces. They’re also great for organizing pens, markers, cotton balls, detergent pods, and more!

Shatter-Proof: Our round plastic jars have a modern, crystal clear appearance similar to glass, without the worry of it breaking or shattering. This makes our jar a safe choice for parents with toddlers or babies, grandparents, elderly family members, and more. Our jars are also easy to clean. Simply wash by hand with warm water, mild dish soap, and a non-abrasive sponge. *High heat from the dishwasher can cause plastic to distort or even melt. *Not* dishwasher safe.
